name: strata
description: Typed, local-first memory for Claude Code — decisions, domain rules, and runbooks Claude reads on its own. Human-confirmed writes, read-only MCP, benchmarked supersession-aware recall. Branch/PR-aware and team-shareable.

vault_path.title: Vault path
vault_path.description: Where the shared memory vault lives on disk. Use ~ for your home directory (e.g. ~/StrataVault, ~/Library/Mobile Documents/iCloud~md~obsidian/Documents/Strata, ~/Dropbox/Strata). Sync it however you like (Obsidian Sync, Syncthing, iCloud, Dropbox, git). Default: ~/StrataVault

repo_name.title: Repo namespace (optional)
repo_name.description: Override the auto-detected repo name used as the vault subfolder. Leave blank to derive from git remote / directory name.

lint_presets.title: Lint presets
lint_presets.description: Comma-separated default presets for `/strata:lint`. Bundled: secrets, pii, phi-uk, phi-us. Custom presets go in presets/<name>.json.

vault_sync.title: Vault sync mode
vault_sync.description: How the vault is version-controlled. 'manual' (default): Strata writes plain files and you sync however you like (Obsidian Sync, Syncthing, iCloud, your own commits). 'git': the vault is its own git repo and each confirmed write is committed locally — pull/push still only happens when you run `/strata:sync`, never automatically. Run `/strata:init --git` once to set the repo up.

git_remote.title: Vault git remote (optional)
git_remote.description: Only used when vault_sync is 'git'. Remote that `/strata:sync` pulls from and pushes to. Leave blank to use the vault repo's configured upstream (origin / the current branch's tracking branch).
